question: Estimate the daily orders on quick commerce apps (Blinkit + Zepto + Instamart + BBNow combined) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total daily orders across all platforms? Yes.
Include only metros where 10-min delivery is available? Yes — currently top 25-30 cities only.
Average weekday or weekend (weekend higher)? Average day.
Time horizon: today (2026) or projected? Today.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: covered city population → addressable smartphone users → quick commerce adopters → order frequency.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Quick commerce active users (ordered in past month): ~25% adoption = ~28M.
